description: SN1 naming lint config (AlembicDashboard). Codifies the SN0 §1 dominant conventions as per-artifact-type filename patterns: React components PascalCase.tsx; hooks useX camelCase; src code modules camelCase (helpers) or PascalCase (model/presenter/class positions) with kebab/snake forbidden; index.ts(x) barrels allowed everywhere (dominant idiom); scripts and configs kebab-case (.test.mjs suffix allowed). The SN0 two exempt families (Drizzle migrations, Agent .profile.ts) do not occur in this repo; the repo-local exempt family is src/generated/ (committed codegen artifacts keep their generator-given kebab names, guarded by the api-types drift gate). Exceptions require {file, owner, reason}; entries missing a field do not exempt.

rules.label: src modules are camelCase or PascalCase (no kebab/snake)

exemptScopes.reason: committed codegen artifacts keep generator-given names (api-types.ts + pin); byte-guarded by the drift gate
